digest.component_or_area: rebar tracker initialization and environment identity management
propositions: Re-cloning the tracker without carrying over git-ignored local state (.env-id, .opcert-key, .opcert-key.pub) silently regenerates environment identity with no warning, invalidating all prior attestations signed under the old identity.

The ensure-registry unit for .env-id minting has no check for whether the store already holds events written by a different environment, despite env_id being discoverable at the top level of every event file.

When an environment re-identifies, attestations from the old identity fail gate verification with foreign_key verdict, surfacing store-wide orphaning only when attempting to claim an already-attested ticket, not at re-clone time.

A second clone mounting a shared tickets branch legitimately needs its own environment identity, and the store cannot distinguish multi-clone topology from a re-clone of a single environment, so refusing to mint is wrong.

The fix must warn loudly on re-identification with prior env id(s) named, attestation consequence explained, git-ignored carry-over list provided, and an override flag to acknowledge it—never silent, never refused, never migrated.
